name: Myanmar
summary: Junta airstrikes hit Rakhine townships as the Arakan Army presses Sittwe
state: Junta airstrikes on four Rakhine townships killed 12 people, including a newborn, according to BNI, and continued across Rakhine on 1–2 Nov. The Arakan Army has advanced to the edge of Sittwe (Irrawaddy). No major city had changed hands as of 5 Nov.
